CommunityApplications.Profile:
Site Manager provides Docker-ready CV, resume, and portfolio site management for Unraid. The repository maintains two Docker templates:
- Site Manager (Admin): full editing interface for managing content, themes, imports, uploads, and settings. - Site Manager (Public): read-only public interface intended for Cloudflare Tunnel or reverse-proxy exposure.
Install the Admin template first, then install the Public template only if you want a separate read-only public container. Both containers must use the same AppData and Uploads paths.
